purpose: Connect narrowly scoped MCP servers with transport and permission checks.

trigger: Configure a trusted local MCP server in Hermes
Add a scoped MCP tool integration
do_not_trigger: Browse a website with no MCP dependency
Give all MCP tools unrestricted filesystem access
Create a PR about unrelated application logic

preflight: Inventory transport, server identity, tool schemas and credential flow.
Pin server executable/package version and validate the network, filesystem and secret access before allowing it to run.
Limit environment variables and host paths before enabling a server.
workflow: Add server config only in an isolated profile or backup.
Verify handshake and allowed tool names without executing dangerous tools.
Exercise one harmless call and confirm error/timeout behavior.
Document recovery and disable procedure for the connector.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record verified server package/source, transport and exposed tool names.
Read back profile config diff, with secrets redacted.
Test schema discovery and harmless probe with timeout and explicit limits.
Owner confirms exact server binary/package hash, argv, environment, network/host access and tool authority.

failure_modes: If server identity is unknown, do not start or auto-reconnect it.
On repeated auth/transport failures, disable dispatch rather than broadening privileges.
